description: Time-aware mood library for scripts/greeting.nu. Bands are matched by hour (0-23) where start <= hour < end. One message is chosen at random from the matching band.

messages: Welcome back.

bands.name: witching
messages: The witching hour. Commit nothing you can't defend.
Everything is broken at 3am. Including your judgement.
The bugs are nocturnal too.
Whatever you're debugging will look obvious after sleep.
Nobody is reviewing this branch until morning. Be kind to them.
The sky above the port was the color of a dead terminal.
Console cowboy hours. Jack in or log off.
ICE is thickest before dawn. Move quietly.
Night City never sleeps, and neither do you, apparently.
The matrix has a texture at this hour. Mostly regret.
Running black ops on localhost. Nobody has to know.
Neon on wet asphalt. Cursor blinking in an empty buffer.
You're deep in the grid now. Watch for the black ice.
Somewhere a mainframe is dreaming. Don't wake it.
Zaibatsu servers don't keep business hours either.
Chrome and insomnia. The classic stack.
Cyberspace is a consensual hallucination. So is this ETA.
The deck is hot and the coffee is cold. Standard config.
Ghost in the machine, and it's wearing your login.
Low orbit, low battery, low expectations.
Data havens and dead drops. Commit to a branch nobody watches.
Static on the line. Probably nothing. Probably.
Wintermute is awake. Of course it is.
Phosphor burn-in on the retinas. Time to power down.
The street finds its own uses for 3am. This isn't one of them.

bands.name: early
messages: Early bird. The compiler is still waking up.
First light, first build. Make it a clean one.
The inbox hasn't found you yet. Use the head start.
Coffee compiling. Please stand by.
Quiet hours. The best code happens before the meetings.
Booting from cold storage. Cache is empty, ambition is not.
Sunrise over the sprawl. The grid is still warm.
Modem handshake with the day. Negotiating baud rate.
Chiba City dawn. The clinics are closing, the deck is opening.
POST complete. All systems nominal. Caffeine pending.
Green phosphor sunrise. Load the workspace.
Jacking in early beats jacking in desperate.
The night shift logged off. The grid is yours.
Cold boot, clear head. Rare combination. Use it.
Neon fading, daylight compiling.
Run diagnostics on yourself before the standup.
Synthwave and a clean git status. Perfect morning.
Firmware updated overnight. So did your perspective.
The console cowboys are asleep. Ride while it's quiet.
Uplink established. Bandwidth unclaimed.
Fresh session, no ICE on your tail yet.
Cassette deck rewound. Press play on the day.
Dawn patrol in the datastream.
Low ping, high hopes.
Yesterday's stack traces have cooled. Read them clean.

bands.name: morning
messages: Prime focus hours. Spend them wisely.
Peak brain. Point it at the hard problem.
Deep work window is open. Close the chat client.
The day is young and the stack traces are shallow.
Good hour for the refactor you've been avoiding.
Full bandwidth. Point the deck at something worthy.
Peak signal, minimum noise. Jack in properly.
The grid is wide open. Take the hard route.
Neural interface at full sync. No excuses now.
This is the window where you outrun the ICE.
Cranial jack seated. Run the big job.
Turbo button engaged. Yes, it actually does something today.
The sprawl is loud but your buffer is quiet.
Max clock speed, no thermal throttling. Yet.
Chrome your hardest function while the reflexes hold.
Straight razor focus. Molly would approve.
The zaibatsu are in meetings. Ship while they're distracted.
Clean uplink, cold logic, hot cursor.
This is the hour the legends cut their best code.
No lag, no latency, no alibi.
Burn the good cycles on the real problem.
Deck running cool. Push it.
Prime runtime. Don't waste it on the inbox.
Signal clarity at maximum. Decrypt the hard ticket.
The console glows. So does the opportunity.

bands.name: midday
messages: Midday. Fuel the meat hardware.
Step away from the keyboard. The tests will wait.
Lunch is a valid debugging strategy.
Half the day is spent. How's the diff looking?
Hydration check. Yes, really.
Refuel the wetware. The deck can idle.
Even console cowboys eat. Allegedly.
Biological subsystem requesting resources. Grant them.
Synth-noodles and a status check. Very Chiba.
Disconnect the jack for twenty minutes. The grid will hold.
Midday defrag. Let the buffers flush.
Your meat is running on fumes. Patch it.
Halfway through the run. Check your ammo.
The sprawl takes lunch too. Mostly.
Power cycle the operator, not the machine.
Nutrient paste optional. Stepping away is not.
Cache invalidated. Time to reload the human.
Twelve hundred hours. Sitrep on the sandwich.
Even Wintermute would pause for this.
Meridian check. Half the cycles burned, half remain.
Blood sugar is a dependency. Install it.
Sun's overhead, neon's off duty. Take the hint.
The ICE isn't going anywhere. Eat.
Downtime is maintenance, not defeat.
Log off the grid, log into a meal.

bands.name: afternoon
messages: Afternoon stretch. Ship something small.
Post-lunch dip. Pick the easy ticket.
Good time to write the docs you promised.
Merge something before the day gets away from you.
Slow burn hours. Steady beats clever.
Thermal throttling engaged. Lower the clock, keep the uptime.
The neon's warming up. So is the second wind.
Grind cycles. Not glamorous, still necessary.
Afternoon static on the uplink. Push through it.
Deck's running warm. Ease off the overclock.
The sprawl gets hazy around now. Navigate by instinct.
Half-life of your focus is measurable. Plan accordingly.
Autopilot is fine for the boring subroutines.
Chrome dulls in daylight. Polish the small stuff.
Low-stakes runs only. Save the black ICE for tomorrow.
Golden hour on the arcology. Commit something clean.
Battery at sixty percent. Budget the remaining cycles.
The grid hums quieter now. Match its pace.
Tape deck side B. Different energy, same album.
Not every run is a heist. Some are just maintenance.
Signal degrading slightly. Compensate with coffee.
The zaibatsu clock out soon. Quiet incoming.
Cruise altitude. Hold the heading.
Small victories compile into large ones.
Dusk approaches the sprawl. Tie off loose threads.

bands.name: evening
messages: Evening build. Tests before bed.
Wrap it up at a good commit boundary.
Leave yourself a note for tomorrow. You'll forget.
The side project hours begin.
Stash it, don't lose it.
Neon ignition. The sprawl comes alive.
Second shift on the deck. The real work starts.
Sun's down, voltage up.
The grid glows brightest after dark.
Synthwave loaded. Terminal warm. Let's ride.
This is when the console cowboys log on.
Rain on the window, cursor on the screen. Perfect.
The arcology lights up. So does the ambition.
Off the clock, on the grid.
Neon reflections in cold coffee. The aesthetic is intact.
Night run authorized. Bring your own ICE breaker.
The sprawl's heartbeat syncs with your keystrokes.
Free cycles at last. Spend them on something you love.
VHS tracking lines and a clean build. Both satisfying.
Corporate firewalls sleep lighter than you think.
The interesting protocols only run after hours.
Chiba nightfall. The clinics are opening.
Your daylight self made a mess. Your night self fixes it.
Hardwired and half-caffeinated. Peak form.
Log the day, then go find a better one in the datastream.

bands.name: late
messages: Late shift. Push to a branch, not to main.
No deploys after dark. You know the rule.
Diminishing returns are setting in.
One more commit, you said. Two hours ago.
Sleep resolves more bugs than caffeine.
Flatline warning. Disconnect before the deck does it for you.
The ICE gets smarter after midnight. You don't.
Burnout is just thermal damage with extra steps.
Even Case had to unplug eventually.
Your reflexes are degrading. The logs will show it.
The sprawl will still be here tomorrow. Probably.
Running on reserve power. Find a save point.
Black ice doesn't care how close you are to done.
Signal to noise ratio collapsing. Call it.
Neon blur. That's not the monitor, that's your eyes.
Wetware needs a defrag cycle. Schedule it now.
The grid is beautiful at this hour and completely unforgiving.
Last save was hours ago. Fix that, then log off.
Rewind the tape. Tomorrow gets a fresh side A.
Dead man's switch on the deploy button. Step away.
The matrix doesn't reward stubbornness. Only precision.
Chrome rusts too. Rest the hardware.
You've hit diminishing returns and kept walking.
Uplink degrading. Graceful shutdown recommended.
The best hackers know when to pull the jack.
